name: rerun-bench
description: Run the same coding tasks N times per agent and measure how consistent and how expensive it is: pass rate, pass^k, flip rate and cost spread.

interface.longDescription: rerun-bench runs each task in a fixed suite N times per agent (Codex, Claude Code, opencode, or a free mock agent) and reports pass rate with a 95% interval, pass^k (all k runs pass), flip rate (two runs disagree) and cost spread. Pass or fail is decided only by each task's hidden verifier. The plugin adds a skill that runs the benchmark with uvx, reads its reports without overclaiming, and helps write new tasks. Real agent runs spend your quota and ask for confirmation first; start with the mock agent. Requires uv and Python 3.11+.
capabilities: Runs a fixed task suite several times per agent
Reports pass rate, pass^k, flip rate and cost spread
Helps write new benchmark tasks with a verifier
defaultPrompt: Run rerun-bench with the mock agent and summarize the report
How consistent is Codex on the rerun-bench tasks?
Write a new rerun-bench task with a verifier
